result.summary: Replaced all 25 error.SkipZigTest stubs in tests/unit/event_store_test.zig with 23 real, executing unit tests (verified by mutation: breaking one assertion yields '22 pass, 1 fail'). 9 stubs became real unit tests, 15 were confirmed already covered by NAMED integration tests and documented in an in-file coverage map, 5 had no coverage anywhere and were filed as ISS-0154/GH#472, 1 (TC-ES-05-02) is unimplementable because the production behaviour does not exist -- filed as ISS-0155/GH#473. Zero SkipZigTest blocks remain. The file also could not import src/event_store at all (its own header admitted this); fixed by exposing store.zig as a named 'event_store' module in build.zig. Pre-write validation was extracted into store.validateAppendParams / store.validateRetentionPolicyParams / registry.validateRegisterParams, which append(), upsertRetentionPolicy() and registerType() now CALL -- so the unit tests exercise production bytes, not a parallel copy (DIRECTIVE T-1: no mocks, stubs, or fakes).

issues.description: TC-ES-01-02/03/04, TC-ES-05-04, TC-ES-07-02 have no coverage at unit OR integration level. All five require persisted state, so they belong in tests/integration/. Production code paths exist; only the tests are missing. Filed rather than silently dropped.

Registry.validatePayload discards the fetched schema ('_ = record;') and performs only an is-JSON-object check, and Registry.getType returns a placeholder with json_schema hardcoded to '{}'. ES-05 schema enforcement is therefore a no-op in production: any JSON object is accepted for any registered event type. TC-ES-05-02 is untestable until this is implemented. ES-05 is marked RELEASED, which overstates its true state.
